definition: very happy; informal and British English
exampleSentence: She was over the moon when she got the job.
exampleTranslation: Cô ấy vui sướng tột độ khi được nhận việc.

definition: very happy about something; informal
exampleSentence: He has been on cloud nine since the wedding.
exampleTranslation: Anh ấy hạnh phúc như trên mây kể từ đám cưới.

definition: very sad and without much interest in life; informal
exampleSentence: He's been down in the dumps since he lost his job.
exampleTranslation: Anh ấy buồn chán từ khi mất việc.

definition: nervous, especially because you expect something unpleasant to happen
exampleSentence: Everyone was on edge while waiting for the results.
exampleTranslation: Ai cũng thấp thỏm trong lúc chờ kết quả.

word: at the end of your rope
definition: to have no more patience or strength to deal with a problem; mainly American English
translation: hết chịu nổi, cạn kiệt kiên nhẫn
exampleSentence: With three small kids and no sleep, she was at the end of her rope.
exampleTranslation: Với ba đứa con nhỏ và không ngủ được, cô ấy đã hết chịu nổi.

definition: angry, especially in an unreasonable way; spoken
exampleSentence: He gets hot under the collar whenever politics comes up.
exampleTranslation: Anh ấy nổi nóng mỗi khi nhắc đến chính trị.

definition: to get rid of anger, excitement or energy in a way that does not hurt anyone
translation: xả stress, xả bớt bực dọc
exampleSentence: I go running after work to blow off steam.
exampleTranslation: Sau giờ làm tôi đi chạy bộ để xả stress.

definition: to make someone extremely angry
translation: làm sôi máu, làm ai nổi điên
exampleSentence: His rude comments make my blood boil.
exampleTranslation: Những lời bình luận thô lỗ của anh ta làm tôi sôi máu.

definition: to annoy someone, especially by doing something again and again; informal
translation: làm ai bực mình, chọc tức ai
exampleSentence: That loud music is getting on my nerves.
exampleTranslation: Tiếng nhạc ồn ào đó đang làm tôi bực mình.

definition: to be extremely happy and pleased
exampleSentence: The kids jumped for joy when they heard the news.
exampleTranslation: Bọn trẻ nhảy cẫng lên vì vui khi nghe tin.

definition: to force yourself to stop behaving in a nervous or uncontrolled way
exampleSentence: Pull yourself together. You have an interview in an hour.
exampleTranslation: Bình tĩnh lại đi. Một tiếng nữa bạn có buổi phỏng vấn.

definition: if you have mixed feelings about something, you are not sure whether you are happy or unhappy about it
exampleSentence: I have mixed feelings about moving abroad.
exampleTranslation: Tôi có cảm xúc lẫn lộn về việc chuyển ra nước ngoài.

definition: to suddenly feel not brave enough to do something you planned to do; informal
translation: chùn bước, sợ không dám làm
exampleSentence: He got cold feet and called off the wedding.
exampleTranslation: Anh ấy chùn bước và hủy đám cưới.

definition: to feel very nervous before doing something; informal
exampleSentence: I always get butterflies in my stomach before a speech.
exampleTranslation: Tôi luôn thấy bồn chồn trước khi phát biểu.

definition: to feel very happy
exampleSentence: After the good news, she was walking on air.
exampleTranslation: Sau tin vui đó, cô ấy lâng lâng vui sướng.

definition: used to tell someone to stay brave and confident in a difficult situation; spoken
exampleSentence: Things will get better. Keep your chin up.
exampleTranslation: Mọi chuyện sẽ khá hơn. Cố lên, đừng nản nhé.

definition: to waste time feeling sorry about a mistake that cannot be changed
exampleSentence: It's done. There's no use crying over spilt milk.
exampleTranslation: Xong rồi. Tiếc nuối chuyện đã rồi cũng vô ích.

definition: extremely frightened; informal
exampleSentence: I was scared stiff during the storm.
exampleTranslation: Tôi sợ cứng người trong cơn bão.

definition: so angry or excited that you find it hard to control yourself
translation: không kiềm chế được cảm xúc
exampleSentence: She was beside herself with worry.
exampleTranslation: Cô ấy lo lắng đến mức không kiềm chế được.

definition: feeling a little ill or upset
translation: hơi khó chịu trong người, không được khỏe
exampleSentence: I've been feeling out of sorts all week.
exampleTranslation: Cả tuần nay tôi thấy trong người không khỏe.

definition: practical and direct in a sensible, honest way
translation: thực tế, giản dị, chân thật
exampleSentence: For a famous actor, he is very down to earth.
exampleTranslation: Là một diễn viên nổi tiếng nhưng anh ấy rất giản dị.

definition: very eager and full of energy; informal
exampleSentence: The kids are full of beans this morning.
exampleTranslation: Sáng nay bọn trẻ tràn đầy năng lượng.

definition: extremely happy; informal
translation: vui sướng tột độ, lâng lâng
exampleSentence: After winning the prize, I felt on top of the world.
exampleTranslation: Sau khi thắng giải, tôi thấy lâng lâng vui sướng.

definition: very upset and not knowing what to do because you have tried everything
exampleSentence: I'm at my wits' end with this computer.
exampleTranslation: Tôi bó tay với cái máy tính này rồi.

definition: to stay calm in a frightening or difficult situation
exampleSentence: She kept her cool even when the crowd shouted at her.
exampleTranslation: Cô ấy vẫn giữ bình tĩnh dù đám đông la hét.

definition: to stop being calm in an annoying or frightening situation
exampleSentence: I lost my cool and shouted at him.
exampleTranslation: Tôi mất bình tĩnh và quát anh ta.

definition: to take what someone says very seriously, often because it upsets you
exampleSentence: Don't take his comments to heart. He didn't mean it.
exampleTranslation: Đừng để bụng lời anh ấy. Anh ấy không có ý đó.

definition: to tell someone about something that has been worrying or annoying you for a long time
exampleSentence: I need to get this off my chest: I'm unhappy at work.
exampleTranslation: Tôi cần nói ra cho nhẹ lòng: tôi không vui ở chỗ làm.

definition: to see the good points in a situation that seems bad
exampleSentence: Look on the bright side: at least nobody was hurt.
exampleTranslation: Hãy nhìn vào mặt tích cực: ít ra không ai bị thương.

definition: to start dealing with an unpleasant situation because you cannot avoid it; informal
translation: cắn răng chịu đựng, đối mặt
exampleSentence: I decided to bite the bullet and go to the dentist.
exampleTranslation: Tôi quyết định cắn răng đi nha sĩ.

definition: to cost a lot of money, or more money than you have
exampleSentence: A weekend trip won't break the bank.
exampleTranslation: Một chuyến đi cuối tuần sẽ không tốn quá nhiều tiền.

definition: to have just enough money to buy the things you need
translation: đủ sống, xoay xở cho đủ chi tiêu
exampleSentence: They work two jobs just to make ends meet.
exampleTranslation: Họ làm hai việc chỉ để đủ sống.

definition: to pay much more for something than it is worth; spoken
exampleSentence: We paid through the nose for a hotel near the station.
exampleTranslation: Chúng tôi trả giá cắt cổ cho khách sạn gần nhà ga.

definition: to save money for a time when you will need it
translation: để dành phòng khi khó khăn
exampleSentence: She puts a little money aside each month for a rainy day.
exampleTranslation: Mỗi tháng cô ấy để dành một ít tiền phòng khi khó khăn.

definition: used to say that you should not waste money; spoken
translation: tiền không phải từ trên trời rơi xuống
exampleSentence: Turn off the lights. Money doesn't grow on trees.
exampleTranslation: Tắt đèn đi. Tiền đâu phải từ trên trời rơi xuống.

definition: to get something that is worth the price you paid
exampleSentence: At that price, you really get your money's worth.
exampleTranslation: Với mức giá đó, bạn thật sự đáng đồng tiền bát gạo.

definition: if drinks or meals are on the house, you do not have to pay for them
exampleSentence: The dessert is on the house.
exampleTranslation: Món tráng miệng là nhà hàng mời.

definition: owing more money than you have; informal
translation: bị thâm hụt, nợ nhiều hơn có
exampleSentence: The company has been in the red for two years.
exampleTranslation: Công ty đã thua lỗ suốt hai năm.

definition: having money in your bank account, or making a profit
translation: có lãi, tài khoản còn tiền
exampleSentence: After a tough year, the shop is finally in the black.
exampleTranslation: Sau một năm khó khăn, cửa hàng cuối cùng cũng có lãi.

definition: to pay for something, especially something expensive you do not want to pay for
translation: chịu trả tiền, gánh chi phí
exampleSentence: Who is going to foot the bill for the repairs?
exampleTranslation: Ai sẽ chịu trả tiền sửa chữa?

definition: to pay for something, especially when it is not your responsibility
exampleSentence: My boss picked up the tab for dinner.
exampleTranslation: Sếp tôi trả tiền bữa tối.

definition: extremely cheap
exampleSentence: I bought this jacket at the market. It was dirt cheap.
exampleTranslation: Tôi mua cái áo này ở chợ. Rẻ như bèo.

definition: something that is unreasonably expensive; informal
exampleSentence: Five dollars for a bottle of water? What a rip-off!
exampleTranslation: Năm đô cho một chai nước? Đúng là chặt chém!

definition: to try to spend less money than you used to; informal
exampleSentence: We'll have to tighten our belts this year.
exampleTranslation: Năm nay chúng ta phải thắt lưng buộc bụng.

definition: to earn enough money to support your family; informal
exampleSentence: She is the one who brings home the bacon in our house.
exampleTranslation: Cô ấy là người kiếm tiền nuôi cả nhà.

definition: having or earning a lot of money
exampleSentence: Since the business took off, they've been rolling in money.
exampleTranslation: Từ khi việc kinh doanh phất lên, họ giàu nứt đố đổ vách.

definition: something that is very cheap; informal
translation: món hời, giá rẻ bất ngờ
exampleSentence: I got this laptop for $200. It was a steal.
exampleTranslation: Tôi mua chiếc laptop này có 200 đô. Đúng là món hời.

definition: to share something, especially a cost, equally between two people
translation: chia đôi, mỗi người một nửa
exampleSentence: Let's go halves on the taxi.
exampleTranslation: Mình chia đôi tiền taxi nhé.

definition: if each person in a group chips in, they each give a small amount of money so that something can be bought
exampleSentence: We all chipped in to buy her a gift.
exampleTranslation: Tất cả chúng tôi góp tiền mua quà cho cô ấy.

definition: to make a lot of money in a short time; informal
exampleSentence: He made a killing on the stock market.
exampleTranslation: Anh ấy kiếm được một món lớn trên thị trường chứng khoán.
